ordering_rule: First integrate the three intelligence modules; then REVIEW_REQUIRED modules ordered by unknown, high, moderate, and low risk; then guidance-ready modules in the same risk order.

changes: Connected the module picker to all 214 verified catalog records and added an explicit result count and empty state.
Replaced raw Markdown output with semantic quick, practical, and deep explanations that keep limitations and provenance visible.
Made the three-control row responsive and verified the final 390 by 844 phone state without horizontal overflow.
findings: The capability library searched only one demonstration record instead of the bound 214-module catalog.
Quick, practical, and deep explanations exposed raw Markdown rather than readable semantic sections.
The first responsive implementation introduced horizontal phone overflow.
records.truth_boundary: A catalog recommendation does not prove the native interface. Only this module's retained audit evidence may advance audit_state.

changes: Added a searchable 214-module picker with counts and empty-state feedback.
Separated recommendation assurance from native implementation truth and now reports native implementation as NOT VERIFIED when evidence is absent.
Rendered both positive and held cases, including controls, reasons, risk, assurance, and application limitations.
findings: The interface recommendation was a static single-record demonstration with no way to inspect another module.
The page labelled local application as PASS even though native implementation evidence was not available.
The interface did not expose held and not-applicable recommendations to a human reviewer.
records.truth_boundary: A catalog recommendation does not prove the native interface. Only this module's retained audit evidence may advance audit_state.

changes: Added a searchable 214-module picker and renders each record's guidance-ready or review-required state.
Shows retained signals, candidate identifiers, closed authority, receipt-chain heads, and recommendation digests without granting authority.
Corrected the no-candidate explanation for guidance-ready records and verified review-required and guidance-ready examples.
findings: The evolution view showed only one static chain and could not inspect the platform's per-module guidance state.
A guidance-ready record could still be described as a review proposal even when no candidate need existed.
Authority closure and evidence-chain details were not inspectable across modules.
